checks.rationale: The decomposition follows the depicted isolation, lysis/marking and bead separation blocks, then retains the independently routed RNA and DNA branches. The library-to-reads boundaries expose consequential material/data interfaces supported by Clark Methods. capture_split is one genuine separation of a common lysate, with mRNA-bearing beads and retained DNA as distinct outputs; separate_dna_signals derives two reports from one DNA dataset. Neither block collapses independently processed preparations. The three left analyte icons are explanatory, and the adjacent scTrio-Seq2/scBS and scCOOL/NOMe/PBAT panels have no connecting route into the scoped row.
